buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the

additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer-Added Bid-Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Bidder experience: The supplier / bidder should have successfully undertaken a single Government work / supply of any nature valued atleast at 11 Cr. / 50% as mentioned as past experience in the document in t he past 3 years preceeding the bid submission deadline (proof to be submitted by the bidder). 2. OEM Experience: The OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) shall have prior experience in supplying g oods similar to those specified in the tender. 3. Documents to be uploaded: a. Bidder proof of registration. b. GST c. PAN d. Bidder authorization by the OEM. e. Proof of turnover of bidder certified by CA - with UDIN number. f. Proof of turnover of OEM by CA - with UDIN number. 4. Financial Documents The bidder shall upload the following documents for the last three completed financial years: - Audited Balance Sheets; - Audited Profit and Loss Accounts; - Income Tax Returns; - GSTR-3B returns, wherever applicable; and - Turnover certificate with valid UDIN. 5. Notarized Affidavit The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on the applicable non-judicial stamp paper, clearly menti oning the bid number and confirming: - Acceptance of all bid terms and ATC; - Correctness and authenticity of all uploaded documents; - That the bidder is not bankrupt or insolvent; and - That no liquidation, winding-up, or receivership proceedings are pending. 6. Mandatory ISO Certificates and Product Compliance The bidder or OEM shall submit valid certificates or product compliance reports, as applicable, for the follo wing: - ISO 9001 — Quality Management System; - ISO 14001 — Environmental Management System; - ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety Management System;

- ISO 7989-2 — Chain Link Fencing wire - ISO 657-1 — Dimensions, sectional properties, and tolerances of angle sections used for Iron Angle Posts. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certificates shall be issued by certification bodies accredited by an IA F-member accreditation body, cover the relevant activities, and remain valid on the bid submission date. C ompliance with ISO 7989-2 and ISO 657-1 shall be demonstrated through product test reports at the stage specified in Point 8, wherever applicable to the quoted products. 7. ISO Audit Reports The bidder or OEM shall upload the latest applicable surveillance audit report, assessment report, or recert ification audit report supporting the ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certificates. 8. Chain Link Fencing Compliance The bidder or OEM shall ensure that the quoted Chain Link Fencing conforms to the technical specifications , dimensions, material requirements, and other parameters prescribed in the bid. Relevant item experienc e documents must also be submitted,Proof Of Manufacturing or relevant Authority Letter must be submitt ed. 9. Iron Angle Post Compliance The bidder or OEM shall ensure that the quoted Iron Angle Posts conform to the grades, sizes, thicknesses, dimensions, and other technical requirements specified in the bid. Relevant item experience documents m ust also be submitted.Proof Of Manufacturing or relevant Authority Letter must be submitted. 10. Technical and Performance Requirements The bidder or OEM shall ensure that the quoted Chain Link Fencing and Iron Angle Posts comply with all tec hnical specifications and performance requirements prescribed in the bid. 11. Product Test Reports and Manufacturing Proof or Authorization The L1 bidder shall, after award of the bid, submit valid product test reports for Chain Link Fence Fabric an d Iron Angle Posts issued by a Government laboratory or NABL-accredited laboratory. The reports shall est ablish conformity with the applicable technical specifications of the bid, including ISO 7989-2 and ISO 657- 1, wherever applicable. Detailed test parameters need not be separately listed. The bidder shall upload proof of manufacturing of the quoted products or relevant authorization from the O EM/manufacturer along with the bid. 12. Product Inspection and Quality Assessment Reports The bidder or OEM shall upload the latest applicable product inspection report, quality assessment report, or factory assessment report for the quoted products, wherever specifically required under the bid. 13. Past Performance and Relevant Item Experience The bidder or OEM shall submit documentary evidence of successfully executing at least one single contra ct for the relevant quoted items, with a contract value of not less than 50% of the estimated bid value. Relevant item experience documents must be submitted, including the contract/purchase order and corres ponding satisfactory completion or performance certificate issued by the purchaser. 14. Validity and Relevance of Documents All certificates, declarations, affidavits, audited financial documents, authorizations, experience documents , EMD documents, test reports, audit reports, and supporting records must be valid, complete, legible, and relevant to the bidder, OEM, manufacturing facility, quoted products, and bid. 15. Consequences of Non-Compliant Documents Submission of false, altered, expired, misleading, unrelated, or unverifiable documents may result in reject ion of the bid and further action under applicable rules. 16. Failure to Submit Mandatory Documents Failure to submit any mandatory document, certificate, audited balance sheet, test report, or audit report at the applicable stage required under the bid, ATC, corrigendum, or technical specifications may result in

rejection of the bid or action under the applicable contract terms. 17. Tender fee / Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) The bidder shall submit EMD of the amount and in the form prescribed in the bid, along with documentary proof. Under MSME category only manufacturers for goods and service providers for services are eligible fo r exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this policy. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 9. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller.

10. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted.
